rows.response_text: To make a flatten turkey recipe, start by cutting the legs from the body at the point where the thigh meets the breast. Then, cut through the leg joint to separate the drumstick from the thigh. Open up the turkey and use the tip of a knife to score alongside the keel bone in the middle of the breast to make it easier to flatten. Turn the turkey skin side up and press down strongly on the center of the breast with the heel of your hand until you hear a crack and feel the bones give way. Once it's flattened, brush the turkey with a mix of olive oil, salt, and pepper. After cooking, let the turkey rest for 15-30 minutes, depending on its size, before carving it. Turn the turkey breast side up to carve it.
